topics.headline: US CPI, Eurozone HICP both fell two straight months; rebound risk brews
topics.summary: June saw US CPI drop to 3.5% and Eurozone HICP to 2.8%, both cooling for a second month on fading energy shocks, but rising gasoline prices and Iran ceasefire tensions create real upside risk for the July prints, making a simultaneous rebound in both unlikely but not negligible.

topics.headline: HY spreads near record tights despite rising Fed hike odds
topics.summary: HY OAS sits around 2.69-2.84% near multi-decade lows even as September hike odds jumped to 67% and BofA now forecasts three more hikes; the July 29 FOMC meeting lacks a fresh dot plot, but a weak June jobs report and warnings from Citi and desk strategists about "complacency" suggest asymmetric risk toward widening rather than further tightening.

topics.headline: BTC ETFs post modest second inflow week, but conviction remains thin
topics.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs added $75.7M last week after $197.4M prior week, breaking an 8-week, $8B outflow streak, but analysts call the recovery fragile absent a decisive break above $65,500, and Citi has cut its 12-month inflow forecast to zero.

topics.headline: VIX near 3-month lows, but FOMC and Hormuz risks loom
topics.summary: VIX sits around 18-18.6, below its 3-month average and well under the 35+ spike from the Iran/Strait of Hormuz crisis, but the July 28-29 FOMC meeting and lingering Strait tensions give it room to pop within 30 days; base case favors mean-reversion lower unless a fresh shock hits.

topics.headline: Deal pace stays torrid: Chevron-Microsoft, Meta nuclear, KKR's Helix all active
topics.summary: Base rate resolves YES trivially given near-continuous hyperscaler power deals (Chevron/Microsoft's 2.67GW Project Kilby PPA, Meta's 6.6GW nuclear procurement, KKR's $10B Helix Digital Infrastructure with Vistra), while states like Texas and Virginia scramble to regulate the resulting load surge and grid strain.
